title: 電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機~Radio-telescope low-noise receivers
focus: 從饋源到低溫 HEMT／SIS 前端的雜訊溫度、Friis 級聯、校正與穩定度工程~Noise temperature, Friis cascade, calibration and stability engineering from feed horn to cryogenic HEMT/SIS front end
summary: 以 ALMA 前端（4 K SIS 混頻器與 15 K 低溫 HEMT 中頻放大器）與綠堤 100 m 望遠鏡（GBT）的公分波接收機為對象，從輻射計方程與 SEFD 出發，拆解饋源照明、Friis 雜訊級聯、量子雜訊極限、Y 因子校正、Allan 變異數與低溫恆溫器整合，最後落到接收機驗收與交接。~Using the ALMA front end (4 K SIS mixers with 15 K cryogenic HEMT IF amplifiers) and the centimetre-wave receivers of the 100 m Green Bank Telescope as reference designs, the course starts from the radiometer equation and SEFD and works through feed illumination, the Friis noise cascade, the quantum noise limit, Y-factor calibration, Allan variance and cryostat integration, ending with receiver acceptance and handoff.

units.anchor: 系統雜訊溫度 Tsys~System noise temperature Tsys
units.title: 輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD~Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD
units.mechanism: 電波望遠鏡收到的天體訊號本身就是雜訊狀的隨機電壓，功率為 P = k·T·B·G；系統雜訊溫度 Tsys 把天空、地面溢出與接收機本身的貢獻加總成一個等效溫度。輻射計方程 ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) 說明靈敏度只能靠降低 Tsys、加寬頻寬或拉長積分時間；把天線有效面積一起考慮，系統等效流量密度 SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff 就是接收機與天線合起來的靈敏度指標，單位是 Jy。~The signal a radio telescope collects is itself a noise-like random voltage with power P = k·T·B·G; the system noise temperature Tsys lumps sky, ground spillover and the receiver into one equivalent temperature. The radiometer equation ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) shows that sensitivity improves only through lower Tsys, wider bandwidth or longer integration; folding in the antenna effective area, the system equivalent flux density SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff is the combined antenna-plus-receiver sensitivity figure in Jy.
units.model: 綠堤望遠鏡口徑 100 m、孔徑效率取 0.7 時，有效面積 A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²；L 波段系統雜訊溫度 Tsys = 20 K 時 SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy。取頻寬 B = 1 MHz、積分時間 τ = 1 s，溫度靈敏度 ΔT = 20/√1e6 = 0.02 K，對應的流量靈敏度 ΔS = SEFD/√(Bτ) = 10 mJy。~For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy. With B = 1 MHz and τ = 1 s, ΔT = 20/√1e6 = 0.02 K, a flux sensitivity ΔS = SEFD/√(Bτ) = 10 mJy.
units.verify: 用校正過的雜訊二極體或熱／冷負載量出 Tsys，再對一個無源天區做總功率積分，檢查量到的雜訊隨積分時間以 1/√τ 下降，直到增益漲落接管為止；把量到的 ΔT 與輻射計方程預測值比較，差異應在 10–20% 內。~Measure Tsys with a calibrated noise diode or hot/cold loads, then integrate total power on a source-free patch of sky and check that the measured noise falls as 1/√τ until gain fluctuations take over; compare the measured ΔT with the radiometer-equation prediction, which should agree within 10–20%.
units.failure: 若接收機增益有 ΔG/G = 1e−3 的漲落，等效雜訊下限為 Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK，在 Bτ = 1e6 時就與輻射計雜訊相等；再積分也不會更好，必須改用 Dicke 切換或頻率切換。~A gain fluctuation ΔG/G = 1e−3 sets an equivalent noise floor of Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK, equal to the radiometer noise already at Bτ = 1e6; further integration does not help, and Dicke or frequency switching becomes necessary.
units.misconception: 雜訊溫度就是接收機元件的實際物理溫度。~Noise temperature is the actual physical temperature of the receiver parts.

units.anchor: 波紋饋源喇叭~Corrugated feed horn
units.title: 饋源照明、溢出與孔徑效率~Feed illumination, spillover and aperture efficiency
units.mechanism: 波紋饋源喇叭產生近似高斯的對稱波束去照明副反射鏡，邊緣照明強度（edge taper）決定了兩個互相拉扯的效率：照明越均勻，照明效率越高，但從副鏡邊緣溢出的能量也越多；溢出的波束若看到 280 K 的地面，就直接把地面雜訊加進 Tsys。總孔徑效率還要乘上表面精度造成的 Ruze 因子與遮擋損失，所以毫米波望遠鏡的面板精度與饋源設計是一體考慮的。~A corrugated feed horn produces a nearly Gaussian symmetric beam that illuminates the subreflector, and the edge taper sets two competing efficiencies: a flatter illumination raises illumination efficiency but spills more power past the subreflector edge, and spillover that sees the 280 K ground adds ground noise straight into Tsys. The total aperture efficiency is further multiplied by the Ruze factor from surface accuracy and by blockage, so panel accuracy and feed design of a millimetre telescope are considered together.
units.model: Ruze 表面效率因子 η_surf = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]：ALMA 12 m 天線的表面精度 ε = 25 µm，在 Band 7（λ = 0.87 mm）時 η_surf = exp[−(0.361)²] = 0.88，在 Band 9（λ = 0.45 mm）時降到 0.61。若饋源有 2% 的波束溢出到 280 K 的地面，加入系統雜訊溫度的量為 0.02×280 = 5.6 K。~Ruze factor η_surf = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]: with the 25 µm surface accuracy of an ALMA 12 m antenna, η_surf = exp[−(0.361)²] = 0.88 at Band 7 (λ = 0.87 mm) and drops to 0.61 at Band 9 (λ = 0.45 mm). If 2% of the feed beam spills onto 280 K ground, the noise added to Tsys is 0.02×280 = 5.6 K.
units.verify: 在近場天線量測場量饋源波束方向圖與邊緣照明；上望遠鏡後用亮度溫度已知的行星量孔徑效率，在數個頻率重複，把效率對頻率的曲線用 Ruze 公式擬合出等效表面誤差 ε，與全像法（holography）量到的面板誤差比較。~Measure the feed beam pattern and edge taper on a near-field antenna range; on the telescope, measure aperture efficiency with planets of known brightness temperature at several frequencies and fit the efficiency-versus-frequency curve with the Ruze formula to extract an equivalent surface error ε, then compare it with the panel errors from holography.
units.failure: 饋源相位中心沒有放在副鏡焦點時，波束出現離焦與高旁瓣，增益下降且溢出雜訊增加；真空窗內若結露或結霜，損耗在饋源之前發生，每 0.1 dB 損耗在室溫下就加入約 7 K 雜訊。~A feed phase centre not placed at the subreflector focus defocuses the beam and raises sidelobes, lowering gain and increasing spillover noise; condensation or frost inside the vacuum window adds loss ahead of the feed, and every 0.1 dB of room-temperature loss adds about 7 K of noise.
units.misconception: 把副鏡照明得越均勻，整體孔徑效率一定越高。~The more uniformly the subreflector is illuminated, the higher the overall aperture efficiency.

units.anchor: 低溫 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器~Cryogenic InP HEMT low-noise amplifier
units.title: HEMT 低雜訊放大器與 Friis 級聯~HEMT LNAs and the Friis noise cascade
units.mechanism: 公分波與 ALMA 的中頻放大都靠 InP HEMT 低雜訊放大器，冷到 4–15 K 時雜訊溫度可到幾個 K，增益 30–40 dB。Friis 公式 T_cas = T₁ + T₂/G₁ + T₃/(G₁G₂) + … 說明只要第一級增益夠高，後級雜訊就被壓到可以忽略；相反地，放在第一級之前的任何損耗 L 都把後面所有雜訊乘上 L，並自己加入 (L−1)·T_phys 的雜訊，因此饋源、正交模轉換器與波導必須做到最短、最冷。~Centimetre-wave front ends and the ALMA IF chains rely on InP HEMT low-noise amplifiers that reach a few kelvin of noise temperature with 30–40 dB gain when cooled to 4–15 K. The Friis formula T_cas = T₁ + T₂/G₁ + T₃/(G₁G₂) + … shows that with enough first-stage gain the later stages become negligible; conversely any loss L ahead of the first stage multiplies everything behind it by L and adds (L−1)·T_phys of its own, which is why the feed, orthomode transducer and waveguide must be as short and as cold as possible.
units.model: 第一級 LNA T₁ = 2 K、G₁ = 40 dB（10⁴），室溫第二級 T₂ = 100 K：T_cas = 2 + 100/10⁴ = 2.01 K。若 LNA 前有 0.3 dB 損耗（L = 1.072）處於 20 K，則加入 (L−1)×20 = 1.4 K 且 LNA 雜訊變成 1.072×2 = 2.1 K，總接收機雜訊 ≈ 3.6 K——0.3 dB 的前端損耗讓雜訊幾乎加倍。~A first-stage LNA with T₁ = 2 K and G₁ = 40 dB (10⁴) followed by a room-temperature stage with T₂ = 100 K gives T_cas = 2 + 100/10⁴ = 2.01 K. A 0.3 dB loss (L = 1.072) at 20 K ahead of the LNA adds (L−1)×20 = 1.4 K and scales the LNA noise to 1.072×2 = 2.1 K, so the receiver noise becomes ≈ 3.6 K: 0.3 dB of front-end loss nearly doubles the noise.
units.verify: 在低溫測試平台用冷衰減器法或熱／冷負載的 Y 因子法量 LNA 的雜訊溫度與增益對頻率曲線；掃描汲極電流找出最低雜訊的偏壓點；把各級量測值代入 Friis 公式，與整機量到的接收機雜訊比較，差額即為未計入的前端損耗。~On a cryogenic test bench measure the LNA noise temperature and gain versus frequency by the cold-attenuator or hot/cold-load Y-factor method; sweep the drain current to find the minimum-noise bias point; insert the stage values into the Friis formula and compare with the receiver noise measured as a whole, the difference being unaccounted front-end loss.
units.failure: HEMT 在低溫下增益上升，若輸入輸出隔離不足會在帶外振盪，表現為寬頻雜訊突升與增益不穩；汲極偏壓過高造成自熱，雜訊溫度隨時間緩慢上升。~HEMT gain rises when cold, and with insufficient input–output isolation the amplifier oscillates out of band, showing up as a sudden broadband noise rise and unstable gain; too high a drain bias causes self-heating and the noise temperature creeps up with time.
units.misconception: 增加後級放大器的增益可以降低系統雜訊溫度。~Adding gain in later amplifier stages lowers the system noise temperature.

units.anchor: SIS 混頻器與本振~SIS mixer and local oscillator
units.title: SIS 混頻、量子雜訊極限與 4 K 平台~SIS mixing, quantum noise limit and the 4 K stage
units.mechanism: 在 ALMA 的毫米／次毫米波段（84–950 GHz），HEMT 放大器的雜訊已不夠低，所以前端改用 4 K 的 Nb/AlOx/Nb 超導–絕緣–超導（SIS）穿隧接面當混頻器：本振光子協助電子穿隧，把天體訊號降頻到 4–12 GHz 的中頻，再交給低溫 HEMT 放大。SIS 混頻器的雜訊可以接近量子極限 hν/k，而 Nb 的能隙限制了可用頻率，更高頻段改用 NbTiN 電極；混頻器、本振耦合與中頻放大器都裝在同一個卡匣裡。~In the ALMA millimetre and submillimetre bands (84–950 GHz) HEMT amplifiers are no longer quiet enough, so the front end uses 4 K Nb/AlOx/Nb superconductor–insulator–superconductor (SIS) tunnel junctions as mixers: local-oscillator photons assist electron tunnelling and the sky signal is down-converted to a 4–12 GHz IF that is then amplified by cryogenic HEMTs. SIS mixer noise can approach the quantum limit hν/k, and the niobium gap limits the usable frequency, so higher bands use NbTiN electrodes; mixer, LO coupling and IF amplifier sit together in one cartridge.
units.model: 量子雜訊極限 hν/k：230 GHz 為 11.0 K，345 GHz 為 16.6 K，650 GHz 為 31.2 K，870 GHz 為 41.8 K。一台 230 GHz 接收機若 T_rx = 40 K，即約 3.6 倍量子極限。Nb 能隙電壓約 2.8 mV，對應能隙頻率 2Δ/h ≈ 680 GHz；230 GHz 的光子台階寬度 hν/e = 0.95 mV。~Quantum noise limit hν/k: 11.0 K at 230 GHz, 16.6 K at 345 GHz, 31.2 K at 650 GHz and 41.8 K at 870 GHz. A 230 GHz receiver with T_rx = 40 K sits at about 3.6 times the quantum limit. The niobium gap voltage of about 2.8 mV corresponds to a gap frequency 2Δ/h ≈ 680 GHz, and the photon step at 230 GHz is hν/e = 0.95 mV wide.
units.verify: 量測有本振與無本振的 I–V 曲線，確認能隙以下出現寬度 hν/e 的光子台階；在真空窗前放 300 K 與 77 K 負載做 Y 因子，掃描本振功率找出中頻輸出功率對雜訊最佳的泵浦點；核對磁場線圈是否壓制了 Josephson 電流。~Record pumped and unpumped I–V curves and confirm photon steps of width hν/e below the gap; place 300 K and 77 K loads in front of the vacuum window for a Y-factor measurement while sweeping LO power to find the pumping point that optimises IF output versus noise; check that the magnet coil suppresses the Josephson current.
units.failure: 本振功率過高或磁場未調好時，Josephson 雜訊使增益跳動、雜訊暴增；4 K 平台熱接觸退化讓接面溫度升到 5 K，能隙縮小、漏電流增加，接收機雜訊隨溫度一路爬升。~Too much LO power or a mis-set magnetic field lets Josephson noise make the gain jump and the noise explode; a degraded thermal contact on the 4 K stage raises the junction to 5 K, the gap shrinks, leakage current rises and the receiver noise climbs with temperature.
units.misconception: 混頻器把訊號降到較低頻率，雜訊也會按比例降低。~Down-converting the signal to a lower frequency reduces the noise in proportion.

units.anchor: 熱／冷負載與雜訊二極體~Hot/cold loads and noise diode
units.title: Y 因子、雜訊二極體與 Tsys 校正~Y-factor, noise diode and Tsys calibration
units.mechanism: 接收機雜訊以 Y 因子法量測：對溫度 T_hot 與 T_cold 的兩個黑體負載記錄輸出功率比 Y = P_hot/P_cold，解得 T_rx = (T_hot − Y·T_cold)/(Y − 1)。日常觀測不方便搬負載，改用耦合進前端的雜訊二極體：它注入已知的 T_cal，由開／關功率比得到 Tsys = T_cal/(P_on/P_off − 1)，而 T_cal 本身必須定期用負載回溯校正。毫米波系統（如 ALMA 的校正裝置）用常溫與加熱負載，再配合天空傾角掃描求大氣不透明度。~Receiver noise is measured by the Y-factor method: record the output-power ratio Y = P_hot/P_cold for two blackbody loads at T_hot and T_cold and solve T_rx = (T_hot − Y·T_cold)/(Y − 1). Since loads are impractical during routine observing, a noise diode coupled into the front end injects a known T_cal, and the on/off power ratio gives Tsys = T_cal/(P_on/P_off − 1), with T_cal itself traced back to the loads periodically. Millimetre systems such as the ALMA calibration device use ambient and heated loads together with sky dips to obtain the atmospheric opacity.
units.model: T_hot = 295 K、T_cold = 77 K、量到 Y = 3.2：T_rx = (295 − 3.2×77)/2.2 = 22.1 K。若冷負載因結霜實際為 80 K，同一個 Y 解出 T_rx = 17.7 K，誤差達 4 K。雜訊二極體 T_cal = 2 K、P_on/P_off = 1.08 時 Tsys = 2/0.08 = 25 K，與 T_rx 22 K 加上約 3 K 天空貢獻一致。~With T_hot = 295 K, T_cold = 77 K and a measured Y = 3.2, T_rx = (295 − 3.2×77)/2.2 = 22.1 K. If frost makes the cold load effectively 80 K, the same Y yields T_rx = 17.7 K, a 4 K error. A noise diode with T_cal = 2 K and P_on/P_off = 1.08 gives Tsys = 2/0.08 = 25 K, consistent with T_rx = 22 K plus about 3 K of sky.
units.verify: 在真空窗前以負載做 Y 因子，每月用同一程序回溯校正雜訊二極體的 T_cal；觀測時記錄 Tsys 對仰角的曲線（天空傾角），用 T_sky = T_atm(1 − e^(−τ/sinEl)) 擬合不透明度，確認扣除大氣後的 T_rx 與實驗室值一致。~Do a Y-factor at the vacuum window with loads and re-trace the noise-diode T_cal against them monthly with the same procedure; during observing log Tsys versus elevation (sky dip), fit the opacity with T_sky = T_atm(1 − e^(−τ/sinEl)) and confirm that T_rx after removing the atmosphere matches the laboratory value.
units.failure: 雜訊二極體的輸出隨其物理溫度與老化漂移，若未回溯校正，每 5% 的 T_cal 誤差就直接變成 5% 的流量尺度誤差，而且會悄悄進入所有觀測資料。~The noise-diode output drifts with its physical temperature and ageing; without re-tracing, every 5% error in T_cal becomes a 5% flux-scale error that silently enters every observation.
units.misconception: 雜訊二極體校正一次之後就永遠有效。~Once the noise diode has been calibrated it stays valid forever.

units.anchor: 增益穩定度與 Allan 變異數~Gain stability and Allan variance
units.title: 增益漲落、1/f 雜訊與 Allan 時間~Gain fluctuations, 1/f noise and the Allan time
units.mechanism: 輻射計雜訊隨 1/√τ 下降，但放大器的 1/f 增益漲落與大氣發射的起伏會隨 τ 增加而上升，兩者相加在 Allan 變異數圖上形成一個最小值，對應的 τ_A 就是單次積分的上限。超過 τ_A 再積分只會更差，因此總功率觀測必須以快於 τ_A 的節奏做位置、波束或頻率切換；對 ALMA 這種寬頻系統，增益穩定度的規格比雜訊溫度更難達成。~Radiometer noise falls as 1/√τ, but 1/f gain fluctuations of the amplifiers and fluctuations of atmospheric emission rise with τ; their sum produces a minimum in the Allan-variance plot, and the corresponding τ_A is the ceiling on a single integration. Integrating beyond τ_A only makes things worse, so total-power observing must switch position, beam or frequency faster than τ_A; for a wideband system such as ALMA the gain-stability specification is harder to meet than the noise temperature.
units.model: ΔT² = Tsys²[1/(Bτ) + (ΔG/G)²]。B = 2 GHz、Tsys = 50 K 時，τ = 1 s 的輻射計項為 50/√2e9 = 1.1 mK；若 ΔG/G = 1e−4，增益項已達 5 mK。兩項相等的時間 τ_A = 1/[B(ΔG/G)²] = 1/(2e9×1e−8) = 0.05 s，所以切換必須快於 20 Hz，或把增益穩定到 1e−5 使 τ_A 延長到 5 s。~ΔT² = Tsys²[1/(Bτ) + (ΔG/G)²]. With B = 2 GHz and Tsys = 50 K the radiometer term at τ = 1 s is 50/√2e9 = 1.1 mK; with ΔG/G = 1e−4 the gain term is already 5 mK. The two are equal at τ_A = 1/[B(ΔG/G)²] = 1/(2e9×1e−8) = 0.05 s, so switching must run faster than 20 Hz, or the gain must be stabilised to 1e−5 to stretch τ_A to 5 s.
units.verify: 對穩定負載記錄至少 1 小時的總功率時間序列，計算 Allan 偏差對 τ 的曲線：白雜訊段斜率 −1/2、平坦段為 1/f、上升段為漂移；讀出 τ_A 並與預定的切換週期比較，切換週期必須明顯短於 τ_A。~Record at least one hour of total-power time series on a stable load and compute the Allan deviation versus τ: the white-noise segment has slope −1/2, the flat segment is 1/f and the rising segment is drift; read off τ_A and compare with the planned switching cycle, which must be clearly shorter than τ_A.
units.failure: GM 低溫機 1 Hz 的活塞週期讓 LNA 溫度微幅起伏，增益隨之調變，Allan 圖在 1 s 附近出現凸起、頻譜上出現 1 Hz 諧波；電源漣波也會以同樣方式進入資料。~The 1 Hz piston cycle of a GM cryocooler modulates the LNA temperature slightly and hence its gain, producing a bump near 1 s in the Allan plot and 1 Hz harmonics in the spectrum; power-supply ripple enters the data the same way.
units.misconception: 積分時間越長，靈敏度一定越好。~Longer integration always gives better sensitivity.

units.anchor: 前端低溫恆溫器與真空窗~Front-end cryostat and vacuum window
units.title: 低溫整合：熱負載、真空窗與駐波~Cryogenic integration: heat loads, windows and standing waves
units.mechanism: ALMA 的前端把多個波段卡匣裝進同一個低溫恆溫器，三級 GM 低溫機提供約 110 K、15 K 與 4 K 的平台；熱負載來自輻射、波導與同軸線的傳導，以及放大器本身的耗散，每一級的預算都要算清楚。真空窗與紅外濾片必須在該波段低損耗，但窗與饋源之間任何殘餘反射都會形成駐波，使頻帶響應出現週期性漣波，週期為 c/(2L)，L 是兩反射面的間距。~The ALMA front end packs several band cartridges into one cryostat whose three-stage GM cryocooler provides stages near 110 K, 15 K and 4 K; heat loads come from radiation, conduction through waveguides and coaxial lines, and the dissipation of the amplifiers themselves, and every stage needs its own budget. The vacuum window and infrared filter must be low-loss in band, yet any residual reflection between the window and the feed forms a standing wave that imprints periodic ripple on the bandpass with period c/(2L), L being the spacing of the two reflecting surfaces.
units.model: 輻射負載 Q = εσA(T⁴_hot − T⁴_cold)：300 K 外殼對 110 K 屏蔽、有效發射率 0.05、面積 1 m² 時 Q = 0.05×5.67e−8×(300⁴ − 110⁴) ≈ 22 W，這決定了第一級的需求。窗與饋源相距 L = 0.3 m 時，駐波漣波週期 Δν = c/(2L) = 3e8/0.6 = 500 MHz。~Radiative load Q = εσA(T⁴_hot − T⁴_cold): a 300 K shell facing a 110 K shield with effective emissivity 0.05 over 1 m² gives Q = 0.05×5.67e−8×(300⁴ − 110⁴) ≈ 22 W, which sizes the first stage. With the window 0.3 m from the feed, the standing-wave ripple period is Δν = c/(2L) = 3e8/0.6 = 500 MHz.
units.verify: 記錄降溫曲線與各級穩態溫度，和熱負載模型比較；用平坦負載量頻帶響應，對漣波做傅立葉分析得到週期 Δν，反推 L = c/(2Δν) 找出是哪一對反射面；檢查真空度是否維持在 1e−6 mbar 以下、長時間是否上升。~Log the cooldown curve and the steady-state stage temperatures and compare with the heat-load model; measure the bandpass on a flat load, Fourier-analyse the ripple to get its period Δν and locate the reflecting pair from L = c/(2Δν); check that the vacuum stays below 1e−6 mbar and does not rise over time.
units.failure: 真空微漏讓空氣在 4 K 表面低溫泵吸，先是平台溫度緩升，接著水氣在真空窗內結霜造成損耗，雜訊溫度在幾週內逐步惡化；低溫機氦氣污染則讓 4 K 級漂到 5 K 以上，SIS 性能同時衰退。~A small vacuum leak lets air cryopump onto the 4 K surfaces, the stage temperature creeps up, then water frosts the inside of the window and adds loss, and the noise temperature degrades over weeks; helium contamination of the cryocooler drifts the 4 K stage above 5 K and the SIS performance falls with it.
units.misconception: 真空抽得夠低，低溫腔內就沒有熱負載。~A good enough vacuum means there is no heat load into the cryostat.

units.anchor: 接收機驗收與性能紀錄~Receiver acceptance and performance record
units.title: 驗收測試矩陣、上機驗證與交接~Acceptance matrix, on-telescope verification and handoff
units.mechanism: 一個接收機卡匣的驗收包含：各本振設定下 T_rx 對頻率曲線、邊帶分離比、中頻通帶平坦度、Allan 穩定度、波束方向圖與交叉極化、雜散訊號；上望遠鏡後再用行星量孔徑效率、量各波段的指向與焦點偏移、量 Tsys 對可降水量的關係。交接文件必須有校正表、T_cal、相位中心位置與操作限制，否則實驗室合格的接收機在望遠鏡上無法重現相同靈敏度。~Acceptance of a receiver cartridge covers T_rx versus frequency at each LO setting, sideband-separation ratio, IF passband flatness, Allan stability, beam pattern with cross-polarisation and spurious signals; on the telescope it continues with aperture efficiency from planets, pointing and focus offsets per band and Tsys versus precipitable water vapour. The handoff record must contain calibration tables, T_cal, phase-centre positions and operating limits, otherwise a receiver that passed in the lab cannot reproduce the same sensitivity on the telescope.
units.model: 教學規格：T_rx 在 80% 頻帶內 ≤ 80 K。雙邊帶分離接收機若影像抑制只有 10 dB，影像邊帶 10% 的天空雜訊（例如 50 K）會洩漏成 5 K 的額外 Tsys；交叉極化 −20 dB 代表 1% 的洩漏，對 1% 偏振的天體而言洩漏與訊號同量級，必須做 D-term 校正。~Teaching specification: T_rx ≤ 80 K over 80% of the band. A sideband-separating receiver with only 10 dB image rejection leaks 10% of the image-band sky noise (say 50 K) as 5 K of extra Tsys; −20 dB cross-polarisation means 1% leakage, equal to the signal for a 1% polarised source, so D-term calibration is mandatory.
units.verify: 在測試平台跑完整個驗收矩陣（負載 Y 因子、波束掃描器、向量網路分析儀量中頻），再做上機試觀測：行星效率、類星體指向、Tsys 對仰角；產出含 T_rx 曲線、Allan 圖與效率表的性能紀錄，並在每次維修後重跑縮減版回歸測試。~Run the full acceptance matrix on the test set (load Y-factor, beam scanner, vector network analyser for the IF), then commission on sky with planet efficiencies, quasar pointing and Tsys versus elevation; produce a performance record with T_rx curves, Allan plots and an efficiency table, and rerun a reduced regression set after every repair.
units.failure: 實驗室合格的接收機上機後 Tsys 偏高，原因可能是本振雜散、相位中心沒對到焦點，或校正表沒有一起更新；若只核對實驗室報告而沒有上機驗證，這類問題會留到科學資料才被發現。~A receiver that passed in the lab shows elevated Tsys on the telescope because of an LO spur, a phase centre not at the focus or calibration tables that were not updated together; if acceptance only checks the lab report without on-sky verification, such problems surface only in science data.
units.misconception: 通過實驗室雜訊測試就代表望遠鏡上也會達到相同靈敏度。~Passing the laboratory noise test guarantees the same sensitivity on the telescope.

example: 雜訊鏈練習：假設饋源與正交模轉換器在 15 K、損耗 0.3 dB（L = 1.072），第一級低溫 HEMT T₁ = 3 K、G₁ = 35 dB（3162），第二級室溫放大器 T₂ = 150 K。前端損耗貢獻 (L−1)×15 = 1.08 K，Friis 級聯 T_rx = 1.08 + 1.072×(3 + 150/3162) = 1.08 + 3.27 = 4.35 K。加上天空 5 K、地面溢出 3 K、宇宙微波背景 2.7 K，Tsys ≈ 15 K。對 GBT（A_eff ≈ 5500 m²）SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×15/5500 = 7.5e−26 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ = 7.5 Jy；以 B = 100 MHz、τ = 60 s 積分，流量靈敏度 ΔS = 7.5/√(1e8×60) = 97 µJy。若前端損耗增加到 1 dB（L = 1.259），T_rx 升到 3.9 + 1.259×3.05 = 7.7 K，Tsys 變成約 18 K，相同靈敏度需要的時間增加 (18/15)² = 1.44 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Noise-chain exercise: assume the feed and orthomode transducer at 15 K with 0.3 dB loss (L = 1.072), a first-stage cryogenic HEMT with T₁ = 3 K and G₁ = 35 dB (3162), and a room-temperature second stage with T₂ = 150 K. The front-end loss contributes (L−1)×15 = 1.08 K and the Friis cascade gives T_rx = 1.08 + 1.072×(3 + 150/3162) = 1.08 + 3.27 = 4.35 K. Adding 5 K of sky, 3 K of ground spillover and 2.7 K of cosmic microwave background gives Tsys ≈ 15 K. For the GBT (A_eff ≈ 5500 m²) SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×15/5500 = 7.5e−26 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ = 7.5 Jy; integrating B = 100 MHz for τ = 60 s gives a flux sensitivity ΔS = 7.5/√(1e8×60) = 97 µJy. If the front-end loss grows to 1 dB (L = 1.259), T_rx rises to 3.9 + 1.259×3.05 = 7.7 K, Tsys becomes about 18 K and the time for the same sensitivity grows by (18/15)² = 1.44. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1933 年 Jansky 偵測到銀河的無線電波後，接收機雜訊一路從真空管、1960 年代的 4 K 邁射放大器（Penzias 與 Wilson 以此發現宇宙微波背景）、1970 年代末的 SIS 混頻器理論與實作，走到 1980–90 年代由 NRAO 中央開發實驗室等單位推動的 GaAs／InP HEMT 低溫放大器。ALMA 的十個波段前端於 2000–2010 年代由歐洲、北美與東亞的多個實驗室分工製作；台灣中央研究院天文所（ASIAA）主導的 Band 1（35–50 GHz）接收機於 2021 年起交付，把低雜訊接收機工程帶進台灣的產學鏈。~After Jansky detected radio emission from the Milky Way in 1933, receiver noise fell from vacuum tubes through the 4 K maser amplifiers of the 1960s (with which Penzias and Wilson found the cosmic microwave background), the SIS mixer theory and devices of the late 1970s, to the cryogenic GaAs/InP HEMT amplifiers advanced by the NRAO Central Development Laboratory and others in the 1980s and 1990s. The ten ALMA band front ends were built by laboratories across Europe, North America and East Asia during the 2000s and 2010s; the Band 1 (35–50 GHz) receivers led by Taiwan's Academia Sinica Institute of Astronomy and Astrophysics (ASIAA) began delivery in 2021, bringing low-noise receiver engineering into Taiwan's research and industrial chain.
